findings.evidence: Compare scripts/gates/m6-complete.sh:98-105 (the only chaos leg is a_successor_that_booted_early_loses_nothing) with crates/oqueue-coordinator/tests/it/chaos.rs:202-260 (the M6.19 test). baselines/review.txt entry d2732bffb5a8 says the rest of the chaos-leg finding 'is M6.19's', and reviews/milestone-M6-56bc9a71c10ea035.json finding 356eac4101c0 cites M6.19. M6.17 set the precedent: it added its own chaos test to the gate as a named leg. M6.19 added none.
findings.summary: The completion gate does not run the test that closes the chaos-leg finding. M6.19 wrote chaos::an_append_that_outlives_its_lease_is_not_acknowledged, but scripts/gates/m6-complete.sh names only a_successor_that_booted_early_loses_nothing for the leadership-change leg. Round two ruled that test unable to catch the in-flight-append loss. So m6-complete.sh stays green if the M6.19 test is renamed, ignored or removed, and the data-loss path M6.19 fixed has no evidence in the completion condition.

reviewer: independent milestone-review agent (Claude Opus 5); did not drive M6
